assertions.evidence: In src/incident-urgency.ts, URGENCY_QUESTION is defined with type "score" and a five-level ordered criteria array; the test asserts criteria length is 5.

parseResponse computes urgency in code via "urgency: roundToLevel(score)" and sortForOnCallDashboard sorts by that urgency; there is a single API call in rateIncident and no second call or model-generated integer.
buildRequest sets state to separate named fields: { affected_service: normalized.service, report_text: normalized.text } in src/incident-urgency.ts.
